notes.title: Brand new mode and map, live-action trailer! Early access available in February!
notes.notes:
The independent game development team Orcano Games has announced that "Faction Z" will soon feature a new mode and map, with a demo and early access testing set to launch on the Steam platform in February.

[previewyoutube=nvYoAg0K_ww;full][/previewyoutube]

During the adventurous journey, players will experience a unique skill system. Skills are categorized into active and passive effects, and upon leveling up, players can choose one from three randomly generated skills and convert it into either an active attack skill or a passive effect. This choice adds a strategic layer, making each player's adventure dynamic.

The upgrade system introduces a random element, allowing players to focus on upgrading a single skill, but there is no guarantee of obtaining the desired skill with each upgrade. The selection of these abilities and skills ensures that each player's character has its own distinctive features.

On the other hand, players can also craft diverse playstyles. Through the skill master in the village, players can perform skill resets, readjusting the character's ability configuration to enhance the variety of their adventures.

As an official example, the "Enlargement" ability includes increasing the size of weapons, thereby enhancing the range of normal attacks. Additionally, within the skills, there is an "Enlargement" effect. When abilities and skills reinforce each other, players can unleash more powerful attacks in battle, making them virtually unstoppable on their adventure journey.

The stage for this adventure is a world filled with unknowns, where players need to activate and destroy monuments to unlock more challenges. Each monument awakens formidable monsters, and only by defeating the monuments scattered throughout the land can players challenge mysterious bosses.

Monuments are categorized into five levels, with the difficulty gradually increasing with each tier. Some stages feature random ability enhancements, turning each battle into an unknown adventure. This not only tests players' strategic thinking but also allows adventurers to experience the variability and surprises of challenges.

During these perilous times, the safe village becomes the players' stronghold, where they can engage in buying, selling, and crafting equipment. It also serves as the location for resetting skills and abilities. Through continuous exploration, players will overcome present difficulties and conquer these formidable monsters.

The official announcement emphasizes that this comprehensive update will bring greater diversity to the game. Not only does it enhance the game's replayability, but it also focuses on strengthening the unique features of the game by injecting more novel elements into the content. The goal is to provide players with a more comprehensive and enjoyable gaming experience.

This is not just a technological upgrade; it is also a response to player expectations. The hope is that through this update, every adventurer can find their unique enjoyment in the game world. In addition to the mentioned content, the team is planning to release more exciting features in the future.

The team strongly encourages players to visit the "Faction Z" page on Steam, add the game to their wishlist, and stay tuned for the latest game information to avoid missing out. They look forward to players staying updated on the game's latest developments and actively participating in the experience.

notes.title: Innovative skill system, the game is about to undergo a major update!
notes.notes:
[b]Faction Z Game Announcement[/b]

The game is gearing up for its largest update and will soon be available on Steam Demo! During the upgrade, you can choose one skill from three randomly generated options and transform it into an active attack skill or a passive effect. Please note that for each skill, you can only choose between an active and a passive skill, providing players with more strategic choices.

With different combinations of active, passive, and ability attributes, various genres will emerge. In the gameplay video, abilities such as 'Enlargement' and options like basic attack range are showcased. Different genres are waiting for you to experience firsthand!

Don't forget to add Faction Z to your wishlist to stay updated on the latest news.
